query: Please implement an embedded HTTP service website to provide web services. The website should have the functionality to handle HTTP requests and responses, support access from multiple devices, and be able to parse and execute embedded code. Users should be able to access the website through a browser, send HTTP requests, and the website will process the requests and return the corresponding responses. Use sky blue as the screen background and navy for component highlights.
